name: Declination
description: Compass needles, a warm north half and a pale south half, each swung to the bearing of a smooth magnetic field.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --a: @rn(-90, 270, 1.2); -webkit-transform: rotate($deg(a)); transform: rotate($deg(a)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 38%; top: 4%; width: 24%; height: 46%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 38%; top: 50%; width: 24%; height: 46%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 50% 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 50% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
